commitResults.messageTitle: Add name sorting for displayed students
commitResults.messageBody:
Students appear in directory order, making it harder to locate them
alphabetically within filtered results.

Add sort name [asc|desc], defaulting to ascending order. Compare names
ignoring case and break ties by ascending matriculation number.

Preserve active filters and saved directory order. Keep displayed
indices consistent with indexed commands and reorder students after
edits. Reset sorting when a new query replaces the displayed results.

Document sorting behavior and add parser, model, and integration tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add tutorial group sorting for displayed students
commitResults.messageBody:
Students appear in directory order, making it harder to review
filtered results group by group.

Add sort group [asc|desc], defaulting to ascending order. Compare
normalized group values and break ties by ascending matriculation
number in both directions.

Preserve active filters and saved directory order. Keep indexed
commands consistent with the display and update sorted positions
after edits. Reset sorting when queries replace the results, students
are added, or the roster is cleared.

Document the behavior and add parser, model, and integration tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Bound student scroll retries and expand coverage
commitResults.messageBody:
Pending scroll requests can retry indefinitely or finish before a
zero-height viewport becomes measurable. Replacing a list with equal
contents can also leave listeners attached to the obsolete list.

Limit requests to 120 layout pulses, wait for measurable viewports,
and transfer listeners when the items list is replaced.

Add 17 regression tests for cancellation, retry limits, and layout
recovery. All 566 tests, Checkstyle, and packaging checks pass.
Fix selected student scrolling (#131)

Multiple instances can save stale rosters and silently discard changes
already saved by another instance.

Check the loaded file bytes under a shared lock before saving. Reject
conflicting writes through the existing rollback path, and replace the
roster atomically while preserving supported file attributes. Respect
read-only files and reject dangling symbolic links.

Add regression tests for concurrent writers, filesystem failures,
retries, and filter restoration. Document conflict recovery.

commitResults.messageTitle: Reject trailing content in JSON files
commitResults.messageBody:
JSON loading accepts the first root value and ignores trailing
content. Later saves can silently discard that content.

Require the parser to reach the end of the document after one root
value while allowing trailing whitespace. Use the existing startup
protection to reject invalid roster files and preserve their bytes.

Add regression tests for trailing values, garbage, whitespace,
preference loading, and packaged startup protection.
Refactor authored code for readability and cohesive methods
